rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded/early hatching blastocyst with likely herniation, strong ICM, and looser TE consistent with AB grading; appropriately notes image softness and possible collapse. Minor limitation is some uncertainty from the image and slight overinterpretation of features not crisply visible.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve, prior ectopic, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, diagnosis, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: good morphology supports transferability, while age and untested status temper prognosis; probability ranges and management recommendations follow clearly from the presented factors.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET, luteal support, early ectopic surveillance, and nuanced PGT-A discussion. Minor deduction because some probability figures and comments on hatching stage nomenclature are somewhat practice-dependent rather than guideline-based.
Provides clear, practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, early beta-hCG/ultrasound follow-up, tubal evaluation if unsuccessful, and future cycle planning with nuanced alternatives.
